description: Uptime Watch: register a paid endpoint your agent depends on; OMENZ checks it daily (and on each report) for 30 days: up/down, latency, live x402 price and payTo, so you catch outages, price drift and swapped payout wallets before paying. Never pays the endpoint. Returns watch_id + watch_key (shown once). By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/uptime/watch, $0.01 via x402.)

days.description: how many days to keep it (1-30)

method.description: HTTP method of the target endpoint (GET or POST)

name: uptime_watch
title: Uptime Watch
